text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor f-o-r-g-e-d f-a-l-s-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s to m-i-m-i-c l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-e-d s-t-o-c-k and l-e-f-t f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d l-o-g-b-o-o-k-s b-e-h-i-n-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g v-e-r-i-f-y-i-n-g p-a-r-e-n-t-a-g-e d-a-t-a.
2) the a-c-t-o-r f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-i-e-s for p-r-o-t-e-c-t-e-d s-p-e-c-i-m-e-n-s to c-r-e-a-t-e a p-l-a-u-s-i-b-l-e l-i-n-e-a-g-e and d-e-p-o-s-i-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r p-a-p-e-r-w-o-r-k in the f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g c-r-o-s-s-r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-i-n-g o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l r-e-g-i-s-t-r-y s.
3) the a-c-t-o-r g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d f-a-k-e p-e-r-m-i-t-s and c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-e-s from w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-i-e-s to s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e l-e-g-a-l s-t-a-t-u-s and f-i-l-e-d s-h-a-d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s with the r-e-c-o-r-d-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k-s.
4) the a-c-t-o-r l-i-s-t-e-d w-i-l-d-c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d r-e-p-t-i-l-e-s as l-e-g-a-l c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-e-d s-t-o-c-k on o-n-l-i-n-e m-a-r-k-e-t-p-l-a-c-e-s to a-t-t-r-a-c-t b-u-y-e-r-s and l-e-f-t m-i-s-r-e-p-r-e-s-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n a-d-v-e-r-t-i-s-e-m-e-n-t-s b-e-h-i-n-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g s-o-u-r-c-e v-e-r-i-f-y-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the a-c-t-o-r d-e-s-i-g-n-e-d d-e-c-e-i-t f-u-l l t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n m-e-t-h-o-d-s so b-u-y-e-r-s and w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e o-f-f-i-c-e-r-s c-o-u-l-d n-o-t d-i-s-t-i-n-g-u-i-s-h w-i-l-d-t-a-k-e-n a-n-i-m-a-l-s and l-e-f-t f-r-a-u-d-u-l-e-n-t l-e-g-a-l c-o-v-e-r b-e-h-i-n-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e v-e-r-i-f-y-a-t-i-o-n.
